title: Banh Mi Sandwich
description: A fusion of Vietnamese flavors in a crispy baguette filled with pickled vegetables and grilled pork.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the pork belly for 2-3 minutes per side or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the baguettes by grilling them for 1-2 minutes or until crispy.
Spread a layer of mayonnaise on each baguette half.
Add a layer of pickled vegetables, followed by a few slices of pork belly.
Top with sliced red peppers, a sprinkle of cilantro, and a drizzle of chili sauce.
Assemble the sandwiches by placing the top baguette half on each.
Cut the sandwiches in half and serve immediately.
